Welcome to the November edition of our healthcare newsletter!
Keep reading for all the new healthcare related developments going on at Flywire in November and December, including our final Becker's Hospital Review webinar of the season. It's stacking up to be a big one! How 3 top health systems are preparing for 2021 Thursday, December 10th @ 12pm CST
Join Edward Elmhurst Health, Dayton Children's Hospital, and Penn Highlands Healthcare for a very special panel discussion hosted by Becker's Hospital Review. As we turn our calendars to 2021, these 3 health systems will share how they're preparing their revenue cycles following one of the most pivotal years in healthcare history. Stories from patients. Learnings from providers. Protecting your assets and your patients With the rapid onset of digital adoption due to the pandemic, PCI-DSS compliance has never been more important. Hear from Flywire's CTO David King on how you can protect you assets and your patients from the threat of cyber attacks. Read the article <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/protecting-your-assets-and-your-patients-an-interview-with-flywires-cto-david-king?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=newsletter]]> Personalization: The key to patient affordability Hear from our senior product manager, Cristobal Leal, on how leveraging machine learning and predictive analytics is critical in solving the affordability crisis for patients.
